title: EXP-337 sign-only-non-discrimination — verified-already-integrated (closes EXP-570; surfaces ISS-2519 mismapping)
target: No data/sections.json patch needed. EXP-337's PATCH-A is already integrated in data/sections.json as section id "2-11-sign-only-non-discrimination" (renumbered with "2-11-" prefix during EXP-450 integration on 2026-06-02, commit ca68cb5). The EXP-570 tracker entry can pop as verified-already-integrated. curmudgeon_review: monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/WIN-066.c7.json (the cycle that surfaced EXP-570 as a holistic carry-over). EXP-337 itself was authored against WIN-066.c5 hole h3.
kernel_of_truth: analyst-baby's detection method was structurally correct for a verification check — scan target file for the patch's old_string. It just failed to recognize that old_string-absent is the EXPECTED post-integration state (because the patch IS a string_replace, so old_string is consumed during integration). The right check for a post-hoc integration verification is to scan for the new_string (or, more robustly, a stable substring of new_string that survives renumbering — here "sign-only-non-discrimination" or "Sign-Only Predictions: A Recurring Non-Discriminating Defense Pattern"). When that scan returns >=1 match, the patch is integrated regardless of old_string state. The escalate-to-analyst handoff was the right move under uncertainty — baby did not have the heuristic refinement to disambiguate.
summary_for_decider: Verification-only EXP. Three findings: (1) EXP-337 PATCH-A IS integrated in data/sections.json as <details id="2-11-sign-only-non-discrimination">, sitting in the part2 details sequence between 2-10-axial-symmetry and 2-12-cosmological-cluster — exactly the boundary EXP-337's old_string targeted. All five unique strings from the new_string content verify present (1x each): the heading "Sign-Only Predictions: A Recurring Non-Discriminating Defense Pattern", the id "sign-only-non-discrimination", the partial heading "A Recurring Non-Discriminating Defense", the verbatim phrase "sign-match against a model the dome rejects", and the closing-paragraph anchor "Auditor rule going forward". (2) The "2-11-" prefix was added during EXP-450 integration (commit ca68cb5 "EXP-450 integrated: 2.13/2.14/2.15 subsections, 2.10-2.12 renumber, Part 1 tier + overdetermined ack") — this is the renumber that pushed EXP-337's freshly-inserted section into the 2.11 slot. (3) EXP-570 tracker entry (target="EXP-337 sign-only cross-WIN sweep: integrate or document block") should pop as verified-already-integrated. (4) ISS-2519 is wrongly linked to EXP-570. ISS-2519 is the PROP-059 Mech-A-bypass critical compliance audit (23 closed-issues lacking verification_pattern) — completely unrelated to EXP-337 sign-only sweep. Decider must re-route ISS-2519 to its own tracker entry; this EXP does NOT resolve ISS-2519. Recommend decider: (a) pop EXP-570 tracker entry as verified-already-integrated with batch_owner=EXP-577 OR equivalent; (b) unlink ISS-2519 from EXP-570 closure and create a fresh tracker entry routing ISS-2519 to either decider self-apply (since the audit and fix loop is decider-canonical) or operator attention. NO data file patches in this EXP.

anticipated_objections.objection: Curmudgeon: "You are accepting the analyst-baby escalation report at face value. Did you independently re-grep, or did you trust baby's claim that old_string has zero occurrences?"
anticipated_objections.response: Independently verified, twice. First grep (node, regex escape) returned 0 for old_string and 1 for the new section id substring. Second grep listed the full ordered details-id sequence in part2.html, confirming 2-11-sign-only-non-discrimination sits between 2-10-axial-symmetry and 2-12-cosmological-cluster — the exact boundary EXP-337 PATCH-A targeted. All five distinctive new_string substrings verify present.

anticipated_objections.objection: Curmudgeon: "You did not find the integration commit in git log. The shallow clone might be hiding it. How do you know the section is canonically present versus pasted in by some non-decider write?"
anticipated_objections.response: The clone is --depth 50 so git log -S beyond ~50 commits is empty by construction; that is a search-limit artifact, not an absence proof. The presence of the section in tip-of-main data/sections.json is sufficient evidence of canonical integration regardless of which historical commit introduced it — the repo state is the canonical state. The commit ca68cb5 "EXP-450 integrated: ... 2.10-2.12 renumber ..." within depth-50 explicitly mentions the 2.10-2.12 renumber that gave 2-11- its prefix, which is consistent with the integration timeline.

anticipated_objections.objection: Curmudgeon: "Why not propose a build.js verification helper that catches this pattern automatically (scan for new_string presence after the old_string-absent failure mode), so future analyst-baby runs do not escalate false-positives?"
anticipated_objections.response: Reasonable but out of scope for this EXP. A separate tinker proposal would be the right place — tinker owns scheduler/audit-script proposals. Recommend operator route a tinker proposal: "verification heuristic: when integration check on a string_replace patch returns old_string-absent, also scan target for new_string before escalating non-integration." I am flagging the recommendation but not authoring it here.
